part: C2 tube-bore comparison and 9 mm-wall relay-ribbon cable clips
status: C2 6.35 mm bore and 16 mm-span 4P ribbon clip accepted for present use
authority: Derek, direct physical report in chat
observation:
C2 with 6.35 is my preferred size from that test print. Make a note that we may try iterating smaller still, but that's good enough for now.

On the cable clips, the smaller size works well, and the 4P cable fits perfectly. A bit difficult to get in sliding from above, but possible when angling and pulling, and it definitely stays put. I think we're good with this cable clip.

tube_snap.smaller_bore_iteration: Optional future tuning; 6.35 mm is the current choice.

cable_clip.preferred_sample: Smaller 16 mm cavity-span coupon on the 9 mm wall
cable_clip.reported_fit: Fits perfectly and stays put; straight sliding entry is difficult, but angling and pulling succeeds.

scope: Qualitative physical selection of the C2 6.35 mm CAD bore and fit/retention acceptance of the 16 mm-span 4P ribbon coupon from this cooled plate. The report does not accept the proportionally scaled 4 mm tube clips, DC-1 pair seat, V-K single-wire seat, complete production back-top print or its support cleanup. No numerical force, damage, fatigue or lifetime result is established.
